ios.desc:
EchoMind- AI Voice Notes is an AI-powered voice notes app that turns your ideas, meetings and conversations into structured notes instantly.

Record your voice and let EchoMind automatically generate transcripts, summaries, key points and action items.

Perfect for professionals, students and creators who want to capture ideas quickly and stay organised.

FEATURES

• Record voice notes instantly
• AI transcription of speech to text
• Smart summaries and key points
• Automatic action item extraction
• Search across transcripts and notes
• Export notes as PDF
• Share beautiful summary cards
• Send tasks directly to Apple Reminders

ECHO MIND PRO

Upgrade to EchoMind Pro to unlock:

• Unlimited recordings
• Long meeting transcription
• Advanced AI processing
• Premium productivity tools

Subscription automatically renews unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.

Manage subscriptions in your App Store account settings.
